name: jira-ticket-creator
description: Create a Jira ticket in project PX, filling exactly the fields a human would fill by hand — summary, description, component, type and project labels, story points on the team's scale, epic in Parent, the story's split-to link, and a sprint given by id or exact name — and leaving status, assignee and priority alone. The description is shaped by the issue type: a Task says what and where and leaves how to the implementer, a Bug follows the standard fixed section set and can be filed as an un-investigated observation, Story and Research get short forms. A feature split into a batch of tickets gets Blocks links between the tasks and an execution-order section in the story and in each task. Requires the Atlassian MCP server.
